name: WTG Gas Transmission
monitor_reason: length and concrete step: WTG is an operator whose multi-state network (reported about 1,808 mi of gas transmission in KS, NM, OK, TX, plus gathering) is not a single pipeline; no specific new-build project with a sourced length of 25 km or more and no concrete step (permit, FID, award) was found. The 710 mi West Texas figure could not be confirmed.
researcher_notes: WTG (West Texas Gas Inc) is a Midland, Texas operator, already named as a part owner of the Whistler Pipeline rows (P0319, P3682, P3683, P3887) and the ADCC Pipeline row P4379. A Pipeline Safety regional page lists its network at about 1,808 miles of gas transmission. Energy Transfer announced buying WTG Midstream in 2024. No page states a 710 mile single pipeline or a specific new project. Not a new row; watch for a named WTG expansion with a Texas Railroad Commission permit or FID. No route researched.
